qualification: Every captured graph reconstructs from its exact complete Kernel delta chain using its own frozen validator and identical value codecs. Candidate additions retain explicit installation, actual checkpoint, raw passive event or reachable-fragment attribution. The premeasurement supplement closes exactly 14 terminal-mask first-creator differences: each complete content-addressed value and other node field is equal, each actual source digest and cause is retained, B first consumes it through the added owner, and the later common reasoning roots in both versions have identical complete encoded values and causes. Every other common metadata/delta identity/cause/order remains exact apart from declared source digests. At every point, revisionB-minus-revisionA equals all actual attributed B deltas minus the explicitly matched A creation deltas; no delta or cause is rewritten. All common fragment values are compared in full, but equality of every private root value is not asserted. Forms are fixed before costs. No timing correction, discarded measurement, future-run result or full graph/caller semantic parity is inferred.
